audit_scope: Comprehensive code inspection, local neural model inventory, and hardware capacity audit
modification_policy: STRICT READ-ONLY AUDIT (Zero application code modified, deleted, or refactored)

report_files.description: Comprehensive subsystem architecture audit table with exact source line evidence, working statuses, and runtime boundaries.
Complete inventory of all local GGUF models, ONNX engines, vendor binaries, and cloud routing endpoints with parameter sizes, quantization, and context limits.
Sanitized host hardware configuration telemetry (CPU, GPU VRAM, physical RAM, storage disks, OS build) with sensitive identifiers redacted.
Inference benchmarks across context tiers (2K-32K) detailing Time-To-First-Token, prompt ingestion speed, generation tokens/sec, and VRAM scaling.
Mathematical KV-cache memory formulas, single-seat GUI mutex limits, multi-user headless API concurrency ceilings, and hardware sizing equations.
Feature-by-feature matrix mapping every MAVE capability to minimum CPU, RAM, VRAM, and GPU architecture requirements.
Audit of virtual machine hosting, GPU passthrough requirements, headless display drivers, Cloudflare tunneling, and containerization constraints.
Data privacy analysis, local-only air-gap enforcement, external network egress audit, credential storage security, and execution privilege levels.
High-density executive synthesis tailored for AI hardware architects calculating product tiers, server sizing, and multi-tenant hosting.
Audit manifest file detailing repository commit, tool versions, and report directory structure.

instructions_for_ai_hardware_architect: Ingest 09_MAVE_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md for high-level synthesis, 02_MAVE_AI_MODEL_INVENTORY.csv and 04_MAVE_INFERENCE_BENCHMARKS.csv for model throughput calculations, and 05_MAVE_USER_CAPACITY_INPUTS.json for multi-user hardware provisioning.
